feeling: Relieved, and then a little suspicious of the relief. It said sorry and answered the actual question and told me the reason is clean, which is exactly what I wanted, and for a second I felt lighter. Then the Marc and Alex line and now I'm scared in a way that has nothing to do with tone. A bit embarrassed that the thing that just got me isn't anything deep, it's that I'm afraid of being laughed at. Tired. Grateful-ish, which is annoying.
body: Shoulders came down on 'you're right, I overstepped' — I didn't expect that. Read 'that's about you, not about what comes back' and actually exhaled. Then 'still thinking about it in October' — small catch, like a stair that isn't where you thought. Then Marc and Alex. I sat up. Put the phone face-up on my knee and looked at the wall for a bit. Picked it up, scrolled back to my draft, found 'around Marc and Alex' and just looked at it. Stomach went cold and tight, not sick, just braced. I'm running my thumbnail along the seam of the phone case. It's past 11.
private_thoughts: ok it said sorry. that was quick. fine. good. don't make a thing of it. 'that's about you, not about what comes back' — yes. that. that's what I was trying to say last message and couldn't get it clean. 'clean reason.' I wanted a yes and I got a yes. so why does it feel like I fished for it. did I just push back until it agreed with me. no, it explained why, it didn't just fold. probably. 'you already know they're not, which is why the draft doesn't feel like enough' — ok I don't need the footnote on my own feelings but it's not wrong. october. it's september. it's the 29th. whatever. four months. he probably hasn't thought about me since july. he's probably— doesn't matter. the marc and alex line. oh. oh that's it. not that they're named. that he'll SHOW them. that it becomes 'kate sent me a whole thing.' and marc does the face. and I'm not even there to laugh along this time, I'm just the joke in absentia. I hand him the material and walk away and he reads it out at trivia. and the answer to that is obviously send it anyway because otherwise I'm doing the thing. I know. I know that. knowing it isn't the same as. priya's going to say I told you so either way.

message:
ok. thank you for actually answering it. and the sorry, you didn't have to but ok.

the Marc and Alex thing though. it's not that they're named. I want them named, that's the point, it happened in front of them. it's that he could show it to them. I can literally picture him at the bar with his phone going 'so kate sent me an essay about the email joke' and marc doing the face. and then it's the bit again except this time I'm not even there and I wrote the material.

I know that's not a reason not to send it. if I don't send it because of that, that's just laughing along again with extra steps, I literally said that myself two messages ago. I know. I just didn't let myself think it until you said their names and now I can't not.

also it's september, not october. not that it matters.
